Do not return hashes; the host binds immutable hashes.", "context": {"title": "David Copperfield", "unit": 25, "heading": "CHAPTER 23. I CORROBORATE Mr. DICK, AND CHOOSE A PROFESSION", "previous_rows": [{"source_id": "en85-u025-b0090", "target": "Мы добрались до Линкольнс-Инн-Филдс без новых приключений, если не считать встречи с несчастным ослом в тележке уличного торговца, который вызвал у тёти мучительные ассоциации. Когда мы благополучно устроились дома, у нас был ещё один долгий разговор о моих планах; а так как я знал, что она спешит домой и что из-за огня, еды и карманников она не может чувствовать себя спокойно в Лондоне и получаса, я упрашивал её не тревожиться из-за меня, а предоставить мне самому заботиться о себе.", "source_sha256": "5b0c2edd9a23261f3c124a55e9103c051e10ad5ca2183c4b5f765a2ebe832a75", "target_id": "ru-en85-u025-b0090", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "5a8f1f673758ece10d2dd01a53b071636d5c98aa25e0b2ff0dd4cfa186ccda0c"}, {"source_id": "en85-u025-b0091", "target": "— Завтра будет неделя, как я здесь, мой милый, и я успела подумать и об этом, — ответила она. — В Аделфи сдаётся небольшая меблированная квартирка, Трот, которая должна подойти тебе на диво.", "source_sha256": "f6b9862e9c7448f3d3979765c8182bfcebd7412cab431b0d2c5082edca53e7fe", "target_id": "ru-en85-u025-b0091", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "2b601e782a1ac5f8ac4413900529fb53bcb39db731a34c0eb0224fbe6460a08f"}], "source_language": "English", "part": null, "book": null, "chapter": 23, "role": "chapter"}, "source_rows": [{"id": "en85-u025-b0092", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "With this brief introduction, she produced from her pocket an advertisement, carefully cut out of a newspaper, setting forth that in Buckingham Street in the Adelphi there was to be let furnished, with a view of the river, a singularly desirable, and compact set of chambers, forming a genteel residence for a young gentleman, a member of one of the Inns of Court, or otherwise, with immediate possession. Terms moderate, and could be taken for a month only, if required.", "sha256": "0a9eeaa8a69b8d58a72ec498cc7e8390e83555697a7d1af2cce8998d92212dda", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[30]/p[92]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u025-b0093", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Why, this is the very thing, aunt!’ said I, flushed with the possible dignity of living in chambers.", "sha256": "3ba1646b9290996f36d27adb8cdc5e202e7baf050c9895e252736324ceb44fec", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[30]/p[93]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u025-b0094", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Then come,’ replied my aunt, immediately resuming the bonnet she had a minute before laid aside. ‘We’ll go and look at ‘em.’", "sha256": "36c72c14d8071c64537550a110d0d52b422ca192d8a9194b89e6b189e6645e0c", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[30]/p[94]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u025-b0095", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "Away we went. The advertisement directed us to apply to Mrs. Crupp on the premises, and we rung the area bell, which we supposed to communicate with Mrs. Crupp. It was not until we had rung three or four times that we could prevail on Mrs. Crupp to communicate with us, but at last she appeared, being a stout lady with a flounce of flannel petticoat below a nankeen gown.", "sha256": "3e75d3c71d2a806c9f277d8670a70d562769514b60ac726e6f1c928c45033db2", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[30]/p[95]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u025-b0096", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Let us see these chambers of yours, if you please, ma’am,’ said my aunt.", "sha256": "ec163130670de99e0f4088d921dc6a94fa57b1828f07b9220d50a5c9e78aa137", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[30]/p[96]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u025-b0097", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘For this gentleman?’ said Mrs. Crupp, feeling in her pocket for her keys.", "sha256": "639b1c5331907ca185e03e165c5402a5e2cfa584848e4a372294cccd7a419a22", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[30]/p[97]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u025-b0098", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Yes, for my nephew,’ said my aunt.", "sha256": "906be2ddb409d7a48ed7f06f1648522e9efb942db863ac77db844589e5cde613", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[30]/p[98]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u025-b0099", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘And a sweet set they is for sich!’ said Mrs. Crupp.", "sha256": "8d1a070ca44e95187b121f43d3ea02bc3c647bd8b20963d1c745d935a266554d", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[30]/p[99]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u025-b0100", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "So we went upstairs.", "sha256": "46a1a69b1cd9a1b3f1d6f2494c2cddcbcbb11122f92381693d469750c509bd27", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[30]/p[100]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u025-b0101", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "They were on the top of the house—a great point with my aunt, being near the fire-escape—and consisted of a little half-blind entry where you could see hardly anything, a little stone-blind pantry where you could see nothing at all, a sitting-room, and a bedroom. The furniture was rather faded, but quite good enough for me; and, sure enough, the river was outside the windows.", "sha256": "ff26337df23c502506e7dc622855b655620ed78be1d7d0aa4e1f12f672463476", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[30]/p[101]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u025-b0102", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "As I was delighted with the place, my aunt and Mrs. Crupp withdrew into the pantry to discuss the terms, while I remained on the sitting-room sofa, hardly daring to think it possible that I could be destined to live in such a noble residence. After a single combat of some duration they returned, and I saw, to my joy, both in Mrs. Crupp’s countenance and in my aunt’s, that the deed was done.", "sha256": "d88e0163cc15e27628bdffd0ed2fba918c137c4b368b9f5a79617fa26054f2b3", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[30]/p[102]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u025-b0103", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Is it the last occupant’s furniture?’ inquired my aunt.", "sha256": "6ba3862f5ecbbd594141582d0850f2e96c41da8730f1db891f35b3d334298782", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[30]/p[103]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u025-b0104", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Yes, it is, ma’am,’ said Mrs. Crupp.", "sha256": "5a28f18f920885bf8f35cf52746ac6697f952a043e38ee8401777fb508de59c7", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[30]/p[104]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u025-b0105", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘What’s become of him?’ asked my aunt.", "sha256": "4f027d07f730ec3a676660cafa560d1d73141a2cd7f7037bca7cef7fc2c4e365", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[30]/p[105]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u025-b0106", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "Mrs. Crupp was taken with a troublesome cough, in the midst of which she articulated with much difficulty. ‘He was took ill here, ma’am, and—ugh! ugh! ugh! dear me!—and he died!’", "sha256": "1f3ea77a9fdec4c3a83c7038007d857b3a049ad4d37b5d09afe56c5a6ad0a160", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[30]/p[106]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u025-b0107", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Hey! What did he die of?’ asked my aunt.", "sha256": "b33f4152d532f323594a93decb3424c89feafb78f50e714cad76bfc1d1f4a2f9", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[30]/p[107]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u025-b0108", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Well, ma’am, he died of drink,’ said Mrs. Crupp, in confidence. ‘And smoke.’", "sha256": "fd9bde7cb9d22a61c74c242d08b91615d50cb2437f107a35d791317cb0fbf4f0", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[30]/p[108]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u025-b0109", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Smoke? You don’t mean chimneys?’ said my aunt.", "sha256": "6a16da1abda5541b5a1bcfd03495ac60a99116366a1562f8efa881a5dbbe8f7c", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[30]/p[109]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u025-b0110", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘No, ma’am,’ returned Mrs. Crupp. ‘Cigars and pipes.’", "sha256": "9b442949f4a737a255f20dcfc6f276f44cee54989f0f01f13e0dc41a76b85692", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[30]/p[110]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u025-b0111", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘That’s not catching, Trot, at any rate,’ remarked my aunt, turning to me.", "sha256": "8f54aaf77799b59097a40810afcc6d89716b90f16a134a464902aee768df0f07", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[30]/p[111]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u025-b0112", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘No, indeed,’ said I.", "sha256": "aa2d0465b04826b1f459098836d1c5b6465b95cb59314af9578d3a24fa5ee9b3", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[30]/p[112]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u025-b0113", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "In short, my aunt, seeing how enraptured I was with the premises, took them for a month, with leave to remain for twelve months when that time was out. Mrs. Crupp was to find linen, and to cook; every other necessary was already provided; and Mrs. Crupp expressly intimated that she should always yearn towards me as a son. I was to take possession the day after tomorrow, and Mrs. Crupp said, thank Heaven she had now found summun she could care for!", "sha256": "2ebe6146fc2d9ced79d3a6314a045a3d85a60b8aaea865b3a7722f8d14dfd982", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[30]/p[113]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u025-b0114", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "On our way back, my aunt informed me how she confidently trusted that the life I was now to lead would make me firm and self-reliant, which was all I wanted. She repeated this several times next day, in the intervals of our arranging for the transmission of my clothes and books from Mr. Wickfield’s; relative to which, and to all my late holiday, I wrote a long letter to Agnes, of which my aunt took charge, as she was to leave on the succeeding day. Not to lengthen these particulars, I need only add, that she made a handsome provision for all my possible wants during my month of trial; that Steerforth, to my great disappointment and hers too, did not make his appearance before she went away; that I saw her safely seated in the Dover coach, exulting in the coming discomfiture of the vagrant donkeys, with Janet at her side; and that when the coach was gone, I turned my face to the Adelphi, pondering on the old days when I used to roam about its subterranean arches, and on the happy changes which had brought me to the surface.", "sha256": "82781a8fbb3cd9cd43f4931b27284039f16a08c813dbb0b31dcc3b4a6becbcb1", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[30]/p[114]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}]}
